errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis tick interval is 5000, but the major ticks on the plot are at 0, 10000, 20000, 30000, and 40000, indicating an interval of 10000.
The description of the y-axis omits the tick interval, which is 1, as shown by the labels 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
The description states the starting value of the line is approximately 3.2, but the plot shows the initial value is the highest point on the curve, well above 4 (approximately 4.3).

errors.text_span: 在x轴的约15000时到达最小值约1.6
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the point at x=15000 as a 'minimum value' (最小值). This is factually wrong, as the curve continues to decrease significantly after this point, reaching its actual minimum near the end of the x-axis.
